name: Quoted title for precision, plain title for recall
when: resolving a free-text title to the canonical Scholar record before harvesting its citations
shape: "<title>" then <title> — the author is NOT a query term (it demotes the canonical record) but goes to the judge as a signal
ingredients: the title as the user typed it
author and year as disambiguation context for the judge
yields: the authoritative high-citation edition on the quoted probe, mirrors and variant records on the plain one; merged by scholar id, 20 deep per probe
misses: translations whose catalogue title differs; a title that is also a common phrase without the quoted probe
origin: the Referee's seed-title resolver (Cross-Citation Finder, step 1)
